source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of Topic 5.2.4 (PDF 131-132, printed 128-129).

blocks.text: Probability (imkan) is baat ka mutala hai ke koi waqia (event) hone ka kitna imkan hai. Jo hum jaante hain us ki bunyad par yeh nataij ka andaza lagane mein madad deti hai.
Misal: Sikka uchhalein (coin flip). Do mumkin nataij hain: heads ya tails. Dono ka imkan barabar hai, is liye heads aane ka imkan 50% (yani 1/2) hai aur tails aane ka bhi 50%.
Ise mathematics mein aise likhte hain:

blocks.latex: \text{Probability} = \frac{\text{Number of favorable outcomes}}{\text{Total number of outcomes}}
blocks.text_alt: Probability = Number of favorable outcomes / Total number of outcomes

blocks.text: Yani 1 favorable (matlub) nateeja aur kul 2 nataij. Probability sirf sikke ke liye nahi; yeh mausam ki pesh-goi, karobari faislon, balke cricket khelne mein bhi istemal hoti hai.
Hidayat (Instructions): Aap ek chhote dataset ka jaiza lenge, measures of central tendency (mean, median, mode) aur measures of dispersion (variance aur standard deviation) nikalenge.

items: Data jama karein: socho aap apne 10 class fellows se poochte hain ke woh hafte mein homework par kitne ghante lagate hain. Ghanton ki tadaad likhein (koi bhi maqool number, maslan 0 se 20 ghante).
Central tendency nikalein: • Mean: homework ke ghanton ka ausat. • Median: ghanton ko tarteeb mein rakh kar beech wali qeemat. • Mode: jo number sab se zyada baar aaye.
Dispersion nikalein: • Variance: formula se apne data ka variance. • Standard deviation: variance ka square root.
Sochein (Reflect): 3-4 jumlon mein likhein ke yeh hisab class fellows ki parhai ki aadaton ke bare mein kya batata hai.

blocks.text: Misal ke liye yeh sample data istemal kar sakte hain: 3, 5, 8, 8, 10, 12, 15, 15, 16, 18. Agar aap class fellows se asal data jama karna chahein to zaroor karein.

blocks.title: Tidbits
blocks.text: Statistics data ke patterns samajhne mein madad deti hai, jis se sehat (healthcare) se le kar marketing tak har shobe mein behtar faisle hote hain.

blocks.title: Did You Know?
blocks.text: Statistics rozana ke bohat se kaamon mein istemal hoti hai, jaise mausam ke patterns ki pesh-goi ya khel mein players ki karkardagi ka jaiza.

blocks.prompt: Class activity ka sample data 3, 5, 8, 8, 10, 12, 15, 15, 16, 18 le kar mean, median, mode, variance aur standard deviation nikalein.
blocks.explanation: Mean = 110 ÷ 10 = 11. Median = (10 + 12) ÷ 2 = 11 (10 qeematein, beech ki do 10 aur 12). Modes = 8 aur 15 (dono do do baar). Mean se farq ke squares: 64, 36, 9, 9, 1, 1, 16, 16, 25, 49; in ka jama 226, to variance = 226 ÷ 10 = 22.6 aur standard deviation = √22.6 ≈ 4.75. Matlab aam student taqreeban 11 ghante lagata hai, lekin aadat dono taraf taqreeban 5 ghante badalti hai.

blocks.prompt: Ek theek (fair) dice par 6 aane ka imkan kya hai?
blocks.explanation: 6 barabar imkan wale nataij mein se 1 favorable: 1/6, taqreeban 17%.

items: Probability = favorable nataij ÷ kul nataij; sikke par heads ka imkan 1/2 (50%).
Class activity: sample data ka mean 11, median 11, modes 8 aur 15, variance 22.6, SD ≈ 4.75.
